_comment: Compile-only projection of Approach B (Program.cs). It compiles the same builder extension and component as Approach A, without the composer (Approach B never uses one), plus ExampleProgram.cs, which wires them into a CreateUmbracoBuilder() chain after .AddComposers() exactly as the skill tells users to. It is in the solution but referenced by no host: the shared reference host can't take a second Program.cs, and a second Umbraco host can't run in the same process. So this proves the wiring compiles; it does not assert that the override wins at runtime.
